subject: MediCore: security form choice + SOC 2 evidence timing
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medicorehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MediCore: security form choice + SOC 2 evidence timing

Hi Laura — great to speak this morning. Quick recap from our discovery and a proposed next-steps plan so we can get your security team what they need without slowing the rollout: 

Call recap (short):
- You run MedTech integrations for patient scheduling and must confirm vendor controls for PHI handling (HIPAA) and EU patient records (GDPR).
- Primary asks: SOC 2 status, encryption at rest/in transit, and vendor questionnaire form preference.

Questions we need to confirm:
1) Would your security team prefer we complete the CAIQ (Cloud Controls Matrix / CAIQ) or the full SIG? You mentioned the CAIQ is preferred when integrations are cloud-first.
2) SOC 2 expectation: do you require a Type II report with coverage in the last 12 months, or is a Type I + SOC 2 summary acceptable for initial onboarding?
3) Any specific evidence method preference (upload to secure SharePoint/Drive link, DocuSign, or we can prefill the spreadsheet and send redacted docs)?

Proposed plan from Redwood (if OK by you):
- We prefill a CAIQ spreadsheet and highlight answers relevant to PHI/GDPR within 5 business days. (attached: CAIQ-prefill.xlsx stub)
- We provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report / SOC 2 summary letter (redactions for customer names/third-party vendor details) within 10 business days.
- If SIG is required instead, we'll need clarification on any custom fields — that may extend timeline by ~3–5 business days.

Attachments referenced: proposed CAIQ prefill template.

Next steps / ask: please confirm which form (CAIQ vs SIG) and SOC 2 requirement so we can prioritize internal owners. If you prefer a live handoff, we can schedule a 30-min kickoff with our security lead (Marissa) this week.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

---
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medicorehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:02:12 -0700
Subject: Re: MediCore: security form choice + SOC 2 evidence timing

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Form preference: CAIQ is preferred for cloud vendors; SIG is only required for vendors storing PHI on our behalf long-term. Since Redwood will be processing patient scheduling data, our compliance team often asks for a CAIQ plus a short SOC 2 extract. If there are CAIQ sections you can prefill that would speed review.
2) SOC 2: We require a SOC 2 Type II report covering the last 12 months. If you can provide a redacted copy of the full report along with an assertion letter, that will work. If you only have Type I, we may accept it temporarily for a POC but will need Type II before production cutover.
3) Evidence exchange: secure upload to our vendor portal is preferred (I'll send the link). If you need an easier route, we can accept a password-protected ZIP to our SFTP.

Also could you confirm: encryption at rest — do you use customer-managed keys (CMK) / KMS or vendor-managed? And where is the processing region (US, EU)? We need answers for the CAIQ sections 6.3 / 10.2.

I've attached our vendor intake form in case it helps (medicore_vendor_intake.pdf).

If Marissa is available for a quick 20-min sync tomorrow, that would be great — I'll copy our procurement lead on that call.

Best,
Laura Chen
Vendor Risk Manager
MediCore Health
laura.chen@medicorehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 13:40:05 -0700
Subject: Re: MediCore: security form choice + SOC 2 evidence timing

Thanks for looping me in, Ben — tagging Dev for technical clarifications. Laura, copying you so expectations are clear. Quick internal notes and questions before we send anything to the vendor: 

1) SOC 2 posture: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit for the period Jan–Dec 2025; we have a redacted report and an executive SOC 2 letter that we can share. We should confirm with Legal the level of redaction for third-party details, but redacted PDF is standard.

2) CAIQ prefill: we can prefill the majority of the CAIQ spreadsheet. Dev, can you confirm the following for CAIQ sections Laura called out:
   - Encryption at rest: we support AES-256; customer-managed keys via KMS is available on Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted model uses vendor-managed keys by default.
   - Data residency: hosted region is US (multi-region EU on request for enterprise customers).

3) Timeline: realistically, SOC 2 redacted + CAIQ prefill = ~7–10 business days if no additional evidence pulls are needed. If SIG is required instead, add ~3 business days for manual mapping.

4) Evidence delivery: we'll prepare a secure Drive folder and provide a one-time link with view/download and request that MediCore confirm receipt. If they prefer SFTP, we can arrange.

Ben — please confirm we have permission to share the redacted SOC 2 report and that you want us to start the CAIQ prefill now. I'll own the CAIQ deliverable and can join the call tomorrow at 10am PT if Laura confirms.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Laura — thanks for the quick reply and the intake form. Confirming plan below so we all have the same next steps: 

Confirmed asks from MediCore:
- CAIQ preferred (we will prefill).
- SOC 2 Type II required for production; redacted Type II report + assertion letter acceptable for review now.
- Evidence upload: please send the vendor portal link; if preferred we can use a password-protected ZIP to your SFTP.

What Redwood will deliver (owners / timelines):
- CAIQ-prefill.xlsx (Marissa) — in 5 business days.
- soc2-redacted.pdf (Legal/Security) — in 8 business days.
- medicore_SIG-plan.docx (me) — short handoff document summarizing the above and listing specific CAIQ fields for PHI/GDPR (attached).

Attachments: medicore_SIG-plan.docx (handbook), soc2-redacted.pdf (stub).

Marissa will be on the technical call tomorrow at 10am PT if that works for you — otherwise propose a different time. Once you share the vendor portal link I'll upload the docs there.
